content.summary: Members of the opposition Congress party protested outside Meta's offices in Delhi on Friday and appear to have entered the building in a video shared by CNN. Members of the party's youth wing are demanding the company restore accounts of party leaders and warned of more protests to come. The Congress party has criticized Meta for censoring speech that Prime Minister Narendra Modi and his BJP party disagree with, and has placed banners accusing Mark Zuckerberg of favoring BJP around the city.
